title: Staff bridge readout: cross-team priorities and blockers
content:
Meeting: Cross-team staff bridge (platform + serving-runtime + private-deployments)
Date: 2027-02-10 09:30–10:30 PT
Location: Zoom / #platform-ops
Facilitator: Aisha Patel
Scribe: Martin Grove
Attendees: Aisha, Martin, Sofia, Diego, Priya, Lena (serving-runtime), Omar (sre), Hannah (private-deployments), Tom (observability)

Purpose: quick alignment on top 3 priorities for the week, surface high-impact blockers, agree owners and SLAs for escalations. Short readout to execs after notes are finalized.

High-level decisions (summary)
- Proceed with controlled canary of autoscaler v2 for Dedicated cluster group B starting Tue 2027-02-15. Canary window: 72h, rollback criteria defined (see rollout checklist). Owner: Sofia.
- Defer full rollout of prefix-cache eviction changes to 2027-02-22 to allow one more regression pass on long-sequence chat logs. Owner: Serving-runtime leads (Lena + Diego).
- Prioritize incident postmortem for 2027-01-28 latency spike (RDW-2126). Target for draft PMR: 2027-02-17. Owner: Omar + Diego.

Agenda items and notes
1) Canary plan for autoscaler v2 (Sofia) — 10 minutes
- Why: v2 improves steady-state GPU packing and reduces cold-starts for Dedicated.
- Scope: Dedicated pools in us-west-2, group B (non-critical customers).
- Success metrics: <5% task failures attributable to autoscaling, tail P95 CPU time improvement >= 12%, no customer-facing 5xx.
- Rollback triggers: any customer impact >3 instances or sustained P95 latency increase >20% for 15m.
- Action: Sofia to publish canary runbook and start test cluster Monday EOD. Linked PR: GH PR #981.

2) Prefix/KV cache eviction regression (Lena + Diego) — 12 minutes
- Context: Regression found in long-context rerun suite; in some sequences KV miss rate jumps causing 2–3x latency for affected flows.
- Investigation: identified edge case in compacted-KV compaction routine; patch in PR but needs more unit+integration tests.
- Immediate mitigation: increase cache TTL for chat long-sequence experiments to avoid mass compaction until patch lands.
- Decision: Hold user-facing rollout; target re-run of full rerun suite by 2027-02-19.
- Owner: Diego for patch; Lena to coordinate test infra.

3) Observability gaps and tracing (Tom) — 8 minutes
- Problem: cannot trace cross-service token-level latency for multi-hop tool calls (hosted -> dedicated fallback -> private).
- Quick wins: add correlation IDs in routing layer and propagate to Dedicated agent; expected to unblock RDW-2126 PMR.
- Owner: Tom and Priya. ETA initial instrumentation 2027-02-14.

4) Private deployments onboarding checklist (Hannah) — 8 minutes
- Feedback from two customers: network egress rules and KMS integration docs have ambiguous steps.
- Action: Hannah to produce a compact 1-page runbook and a sample terraform snippet by 2027-02-18. Include a short troubleshooting section for common KMS errors.

5) Capacity forecast and infra spend (Priya) — 10 minutes
- Near-term: projected 8% increase in Dedicated GPU-hours month-over-month driven by two new enterprise signups.
- Risk: temporary shortage on rtx-a800 region in late Feb due to cloud provider maintenance window.
- Mitigation: Priya to request burst quota and pre-warm fallback pool; if not approved, shift some reweighting to us-east.
- Action: Priya will publish a short capacity heatmap and cost delta (sheet RDW-capacity-022) by 2027-02-12.

Cross-team blockers (actionable)
- Blocker A: Canary cannot start until staging autoscaler image is signed by security (security scan queue delayed). Owner: Sofia; blocker owner: Security review team; escalation path: RAS (security lead) if not cleared by 2027-02-12. Linked artifact: JIRA RDW-2184.
- Blocker B: Observability tracing requires a small protocol change that will touch client SDKs; need coordination with developer-experience. Owner: Tom; blocker: devexp bandwidth. Requested support: DevEx to allocate 2 engineer-days in week of 2027-02-14.
- Blocker C: Long-sequence rerun infra times out on nightly runs (timeouts >6h). Owner: Lena; infra ticket opened to increase job timeouts and add retry behavior.

Action items (owner / due date)
- Sofia: Publish autoscaler canary runbook + roll-forward/rollback checklist. Due: 2027-02-12.
- Diego: Land compaction patch + additional regression tests; coordinate canary window gating. Due: 2027-02-18.
- Omar + Diego: Draft PMR for 2027-01-28 latency spike (RDW-2126). Due: 2027-02-17.
- Tom + Priya: Implement correlation ID propagation in routing layer and Dedicated agent. Due: 2027-02-14.
- Hannah: Private onboarding 1-page runbook + terraform snippet. Due: 2027-02-18.
- Priya: Capacity heatmap + cost delta (RDW-capacity-022). Due: 2027-02-12.
- Martin: Share notes and short exec readout (1 slide) by 2027-02-12.

Risks and open questions
- Q1: If autoscaler canary shows higher-than-expected task churn, do we prefer a narrower traffic percentage or additional safety hooks? Decision by Friday if PR metrics are noisy.
- Q2: Do we add tracing correlation IDs to all internal requests now, or phase by route? Phased approach preferred but needs a spec. Owner: Tom to propose phased spec by 2027-02-12.
- Q3: Is the Dedicated fallback policy for hosted API users acceptable for customers with strict isolation? Product needs to sign off on the canary scope. Action: Product review requested (product-hosted-api).

Notes / quick impressions
- Tone: broadly optimistic; teams have clear owners. Biggest near-term risk is security scan queue affecting the canary start.
- Suggested follow-up: 15-minute check-in on Tuesday 2027-02-15 to confirm autoscaler canary started cleanly and to publish any immediate telemetry.

Appendix: quick links and logs referenced in meeting
- Incident: RDW-2126 (latency spike) — https://jira.internal.redwood/RDW-2126
- Canary PR: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/981
- Capacity sheet: drive/folders/RDW-capacity-022
- Slack thread: #platform-ops "rollout-canary-2027-02"

Scribe note: Please add any missing owners or corrections inline; will update final exec readout slide after confirmation of owners / due dates.
